scientific_scope_status: The acquired bank compresses into35 homogeneous-quartic coefficients on a unit quaternion. Completed source-version reviews accept rational rotation outputs with exact global empirical lower certificates, a low-degree SOS branch plus an uncapped finite-grid fallback, and separately the generic fixed-universal-template expected polynomial bit-complexity theorem. One non-SOS Choi-Lam-derived instance has a completed exact global certificate. The same-bank candidate is connected to an actual finite35-logical-qubit guarded model operation.

unavailable_or_unclassified: Exact empirical optimality is not future physical fidelity or an acquired stationarity promise. The generic four-variable resultant template is not a completed generic solver implementation; finite SOS successes do not prove a fast worst-case oracle. Candidate-dependent runtime needs source-clock padding/isolation. The60,000-call retained-bank comparison is counterfactual from one actual final bath, not repeated sequential reset operations. Ordinary SLSQP gives identical rational candidates/yield and Nelder-Mead is comparable. No unique solver advantage, hardware or total-cost superiority.
